source: FFX-2 Steam build 25501027; kernel/monster.bin row 164 (id 0x10a4, formation 0393 bsyt05_229, the Besaid Temple Valefor), read by the RE parity session (research/re-ffx2-yojimbo-valefor.md, origin/re-ffx2-yojimbo-valefor at 91ef1fd3, sections 3 to 5). Numbers only. 'decoded' is the proved columns by the note's column map (section 3) and 'unmapped' the columns the note marks unmapped, each value at the record offset 'columns' gives (the row's bytes are not kept; the English copy, bytes 8 to 199 equal in all ten locale copies); tests/unit/chapters/besaid-valefor-data.test.ts checks that the row has exactly those fields and that the offsets fit the 200-byte row without overlap. 'research' is research/ffx2-fallen-aeons.md section 7.1 (SinirothX + FF Wiki, [verified: 2 sources]) for the same monster.

columns.note: Offsets from the start of the 200-byte monster.bin row (the note's column map, section 3, and its unmapped table); the row's bytes themselves are not kept.

decoded.resist1: 0x20 (24 bytes; one byte per index, keyed by index, zeros left out)
decoded.resist2: 0x38 (24 bytes; one byte per index, keyed by index, zeros left out)
decoded.abilities: 0x70 (32 bytes; 16 ids of 2 bytes, zeros left out)
decoded.dropItems: 0xac (8 bytes; 2 bytes each: common id, count, rare id, count)
decoded.stealItems: 0xb4 (8 bytes; 2 bytes each: common id, count, rare id, count)
decoded.bribeItems: 0xbc (8 bytes; 2 bytes each: common id, count, rare id, count)

unmapped.specialBits7and8: 0x1a (2 bytes; bits 7 and 8 of the special word)
unmapped.group1ResistSlots17and18: 0x31 (2 bytes; the group-1 resist bytes at indexes 17 and 18)
unmapped.elementBits6and7: 0x1c (4 bytes; bits 6 and 7 of the four element bytes, 1 if any of the four has the bit)

unmapped.note: Columns the RE note marks unmapped (raw N): carried here as raw numbers, wired to nothing (AGENTS.md hard rule 6).

newInRow: status immunities (group 1 slots 0 to 8 and 10; group 2 slots 6 and 14)

scene.source: pos_bsyt05_229.psc (PlayerPos and EnemyPos lines), byte for byte Ixion's, via the RE review of 2026-10-14 (research/re-ai-valefor note); numbers only: the game's ground-plane units, x across and z into the scene

script.source: m164, the game's own AI script, read by the RE session (review of 2026-10-14); numbers only
turn: gauge >= 100: Energy Blast on all, gauge and Rays fired reset
else gauge >= 60 and fewer than 2 Rays fired: Energy Ray
else gauge >= 30 and 0 Rays fired: Energy Ray
else gauge + 5, then random() % 3: 0 Sonic Wings, 1 or 2 Attack

rng.random: stream 2, one draw per attack-class turn only

commandRows.source: monmagic.bin rows 0x4091 to 0x4093 (offset 0x20 + 136 x (id - 0x4000)), read byte by byte by the RE session; research/re-ffx2-ai-valefor.md section 3 and the appendix. Numbers only; the shape is FFX2CommandRecord; hex ids and words written as decimal

cadence.rule: recovery = cost_atb x 10000 / (AGI + 1) units, charge = cost_cast x 10000 / (AGI + 1) units, 95 units a step at normal speed, 29.97 steps a second, rounded up to whole steps; her AGI is 125
